"""Real open data replayed through the twin, with live ML inference. Two twins stream real records through the platform (MQTT -> Ditto -> InfluxDB), advancing with the model clock, and show what the ML model says about each record next to the truth: qc-01 flotation quality analyser — one hour of a real flotation plant per model hour (Kaggle "Quality Prediction in a Mining Process", CC0). The soft sensor estimates % SiO2 in the concentrate *now*; the lab assay arrives 3 h later, as at a real plant. sm-01 seismic monitoring station — one real shift record per model shift (UCI "seismic-bumps", CC BY 4.0); the classifier gives the probability of a hazardous next shift. mwd-01 MWD rock-type classifier — one real blasting round per model hour (NGI, 15 Norwegian tunnels, Zenodo 10358374, CC BY 4.0): the drilling statistics go through a multiclass GBM, and the predicted rock is shown next to the geologist's mapping of the same round. en-01 energy profile of a mining and processing plant — one real half hour per model half hour (Zenodo 20647907, CC BY-SA 4.0): total active and reactive power and the GBM forecast of the load 2 h ahead. Only the hold-out part of each dataset (the last 20 %, never seen in training) is replayed, so the errors shown on the stand are honest. def load_env():
    env = {}
    try:
        with open(ENV_FILE, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            for line in fh:
                line = line.strip()
                if line and not line.startswith("#") and "=" in line:
                    k, v = line.split("=", 1)
                    env[k] = v
    except FileNotFoundError:
        pass
    env.update({k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k in ("DITTO_PASSWORD", "DITTO_PORT", "INFLUXDB_TOKEN")})
    return env


ENV = load_env()
HOST = ENV.get("OPENEGIZ_PUBLIC_HOST", "localhost")
DITTO = os.environ.get("TWINCTL_DITTO") or f"http://127.0.0.1:{ENV.get('DITTO_PORT', '8080')}/api/2"
INFLUX = f"http://127.0.0.1:{ENV.get('INFLUXDB_PORT', '8086')}"
